title: BEYOND GENRE: DIAGNOSING BIAS IN MUSIC EMBEDDINGS USING CONCEPT ACTIVATION VECTORS

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the alignment of genre-specific audio embeddings with singer gender concepts (e.g., female vs. male vocals) using Concept Activation Vectors (CAVs) and computing TCAV scores.
Evaluating the alignment of genre-specific audio embeddings with sung language concepts (e.g., Portuguese) using Concept Activation Vectors (CAVs) and computing TCAV scores.
